highlights.title: La debacle electoral de la CDU del canciller Merz pone en cuestión la coalición de gobierno
highlights.summary: La extrema derecha de AfD no detiene su avance en Alemania. La crisis estructural en la que se encuentra sumido el país coloca bajo presión al canciller

highlights.title: Fouzi Lekjaa: un fichaje tecnócrata y futbolístico para el Gobierno del Mundial en Marruecos
highlights.summary: Presidente de la Federación de Fútbol, ministro del área económica y con apenas dos meses en la política partidista, el flamante candidato oficialista aspira a la jefatura del Ejecutivo tras las elecciones del 23 de septiembre

highlights.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
highlights.summary: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin.

highlights.title: Imran Khan’s family says three sisters detained ahead of Islamabad march
highlights.summary: Imran Khan’s family says three of his sisters have been detained in Lahore ahead of a march demanding his release.

highlights.title: Internacional anuncia demissão do técnico Paulo Pezzolano
highlights.summary: Auxiliar técnico permanente do Colorado, Pablo Fernandez comandará as próximas atividades da equipe gaúcha no CT Parque Gigante, em Porto Alegre

highlights.title: US, China discuss AI safety ahead of Trump-Xi summit
highlights.summary: US and Chinese officials discussed creating a mechanism to communicate over potentially serious AI incidents during talks in New York on Sunday, as the two sides sought progress on technology and trade ahead of this week’s Trump-Xi summit.
